facts.name: Japanese Forest Grass
facts.notes: Gold blades spill over the bed edge like a waterfall and turn coppery in fall. Slow to get going, but long-lived.

sources.title: English Gardens: Golden Variegated Hakone Grass

companions.why: Combines well with hosta and ferns; eye-catching near dark-leaved Heuchera, Pulmonaria or Brunnera; a backdrop for dark astilbe.
